subject: parser: Support VECTOR type (#54246)
summary: Adds VECTOR as an unreserved keyword and extends the parser grammar to accept VECTOR type syntax (including optional element-type specifier like VECTOR<FLOAT> and optional length). Introduces internal type code mysql.TypeTiDBVectorFloat32 and string/type mappings, and updates FieldType formatting helpers. Planner preprocessor explicitly rejects VECTOR in column definitions and CAST expressions with "vector type is not supported"; adds parser and expression integration tests to lock in parse-accept-but-not-supported behavior.
